Some news: I'm joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products!

I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.

I'm excited to work with @thsottiaux, an incredible PM team, and everyone across OpenAI. Together, we'll build agents that have your back and your team's, and keep you in control, so you get more time for the people and work you love.

Lots to learn, and lots to build. Please keep your feedback coming!

Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and Cisco—alongside our own at OpenAI—are already putting it to work.

GPT-6 Cyber is available to select Daybreak Red customers and we are expanding access over time.

https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber/

Our security researchers built an autonomous cyber vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline.

In a single run with an upcoming cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel at a total API cost of $1.2 million.

Introducing Personal Finance in Claude, in beta in the US.

Connect the accounts you choose, and Claude answers your money questions in everyday language, from your own balances and transactions. Access is read-only, and Claude can't move, manage, or invest your money.

Meet AlloyDB Express

Instant, scale-to-zero PostgreSQL built for developers and coding agents. Spin up a database in <2 seconds with built-in AI, zero idle compute costs and a 1-click upgrade to production.

Learn more and start building → https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/databases/introducing-alloydb-express-for-rapid-testing-and-prototyping

With direct Iceberg access in AlloyDB, you can now query historical lakehouse data and live operational data in one single PostgreSQL query—no copies needed:

- Avoid slow, complex data pipelines
- Share trusted context in Knowledge Catalog
- Register tables in the Lakehouse

A security researcher scanned 514 reachable MCP servers and found 195 of them, 38%, expose tools with no authentication at all, while February 2026 alone produced seven CVEs for unauthenticated remote code execution, three sharing identical root causes and one published as a zero-day six months after the vendor was notified. 

That makes this a disclosure problem rather than a vulnerability problem, because the responsible disclosure model assumes recipients have security teams, contact addresses and patch processes that most MCP maintainers simply do not.

Here's what the industry needs at the protocol level, the registry level and the developer education level: https://buff.ly/ZpRb2Lq

【Claude Code裏技 #4】その deny、止めたつもりになってませんか

Bash(curl *) を deny に書いても、次の形は止まりません（公式より）
・/usr/bin/curl
・sh -c 'curl ...'

公式も「セキュリティ境界ではない」と書いています。本当に止めるならサンドボックスと併用を。
